newsitem.title: USA: National-Standard to form joint venture in S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: National-Standard to form joint venture in S.Korea.

text.p: National-Standard Co said Monday it would join with Korea Sangsa Co to form a joint venture company in South Korea called Korea Standard International.

The company said the venture would produce filter assemblies and raw material for the growing automotive airbag market in the Asia-Pacific region. The venture, to be situated in Okcheon, near Seoul, will have a sales capacity of $9 million at startup, National-Standard said.
The venture still requires the approval of the South Korean government. Operations are expected to be launched in October.
National-Standard makes wire and wire-related products.
Its stock was up 1/8 Monday afternoon at 6-3/4.
